title: Bai 2
en: Read the following small talks and then do the tasks that follow.
I'm a student at Chu Van An high school.
I am in class 10A with forty-five other students.
I study meny subjects such as Maths, Phisics, Chemistry, Biology, Literature, History, Geography, and so on.
I like to learn English best because it is an international language.
I don't really like getting up early, but I have to
because I often have a lesson at 7:15.
I teach English at Chu Van An High school.
It is one of the bigget schools in Ha Noi.
Teaching is hard work, but I enjoy it
because I love working with children.
We live in a small flat above a corner shop in Tay Son street.
The flat is fer from Phong's school so he usually goes to school by bike.
He has to ride his bike in narrow and crowded streets to get to school.
There's so much traffic, so many cars, motorbikes and bicycles.

title: Bai 20
en: Fill each blank with an -ing or to + infinitive form of the verb in brackets.
I have been expecting to hear from you.
Last night I went to a party at one of my classmates' home.
You know I usually avoid going to parties because I have trouble remembering people's names.
Well, last night things were different.
Before the party, I read a book about improving memory.
I practised doing some of memory exercises.
As a result, I stopped worrying about what people think about me,
and I tried to pay attention to what people were saying.
I'm even planning to go dancing with a guy from my class.
Why don't you consider visiting me?
I always enjoy hrearing from you.
